title: SessionReadyMessage
description: First message on an authenticated realtime connection, produced by the tick that accepted the session. It tells the client what the server decided: which session it is, which world it joined, WHO IT IS (actor_id), and the world's tick rate. The client never asserts any of these - it learns them here. The envelope tick is the session's opening tick and is the same tick carried by the SESSION_OPENED domain event.

session_id.description: Server-generated id of this connection's session. A reconnect is a NEW session with a new id; nothing is resumed.

world_id.description: World (shard) the session joined. Matches the world_id of every domain event this session causes.

actor_id.description: Acting entity the server decided from the authenticated credential. The client cannot choose or send this; it is told what it is.

tick_hz.description: Simulation ticks per real second for this world. Fixed for the world's lifetime (ADR-0006 section 3): it is the divisor of the game calendar already written into stored events.

server_version.description: Server build version, for logs and bug reports only. Never used for feature gating - compatibility is decided per type by schema_version.
